rv.q: Audiences looking for something less bombastic will adore this warm hug of a show.
Musical Theatre West’s Little Women makes it well worth the wait.
What a wonderful, sincere telling of this classic story with the exceptionally talented cast I have come to expect from this theater.

cn.t: Critics broadly praise this musical adaptation of Alcott's classic, highlighting its soaring score and talented cast. A heartfelt, well-staged production that resonates across generations.
